explanation: The value is 0 at every GO and D2 step and at all D1 steps before about trial 85; it only fires at D1 late in the episode (trial 85 and later) while the agent has been choosing a1, rising to 8-10 when the previous trial went unrewarded (most reliably after an a1 that led to rare S2, or after a second loss in a row). It is about 6 when the previous trial was rewarded but came through a rare transition, 0-3 after a rewarded common trial or a first lone loss, and 0 whenever the agent has been choosing a2.
